subject: Application for CAD Draftsperson (Student), Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the CAD Draftsperson (Student) role listed on the AR Civil Consultancy website. The role is open to people who have recently completed an Advanced Diploma in Civil Construction Design, which is the qualification I have just finished.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am Melton based, hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Your work on road widening and drainage design for local infrastructure upgrades is the kind of drafting I would like to learn on. My AutoCAD, Civil 3D and Revit experience comes from study rather than a paid drafting job, so I would value the mentoring the role offers.

Would you be open to a short call or a meeting at your St Kilda Road office? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.subject: Application for CAD Draftsperson (Student)
paragraphs: I am applying for the CAD Draftsperson (Student) role on your website. It is offered to people who have recently completed a Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Civil Construction Design, and I finished my Advanced Diploma in February 2026.

My course at the Albright Institute of Business and Language covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage. I prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, modelled a pedestrian truss bridge in Revit, and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries to design around existing services. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings against the work, carried out inspections and quality checks, and prepared site reports and material records. That taught me why accurate, up to date drawings matter to the people building from them.

I live in Melton, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. My drafting experience is from study, not a paid drafting role, so I would welcome the guidance your team offers while I revise drawings from engineer feedback.
Thank you for considering my application. Drawings from my course are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.
